1ef6ddce-7930-45ae-a335-9a45604b99f7.title: Genjitsushugi Yuusha no Oukoku Saikenki
1ef6ddce-7930-45ae-a335-9a45604b99f7.altTitle: A Realist Hero's Kingdom Restoration Chronicle
1ef6ddce-7930-45ae-a335-9a45604b99f7.description:
"O, Hero!"

With that cliched line, Kazuya Souma found himself summoned to another world and his adventure - did not begin. After he presents his plan to strengthen the country economically and militarily, the king cedes the throne to him and Souma finds himself saddled with ruling the nation! What's more, he's betrothed to the king's daughter now!? In order to get the country back on its feet, Souma calls the wise, the talented, and the gifted to his side. Five people gather before the newly crowned Souma. Just what are the many talents and abilities they possess!? 

What path will his outlook as a realist take Souma and the people of his country down?

0689698a-463e-46a2-a2fc-59b7bc5276d2.description: One day, Sylva realized that he reincarnated into a mob soldier from the game that he was hooked on in his previous life. Even though he utilizes his game knowledge to do his utmost best to survive in this dangerous world, he opts to hide his true strength in order not to throw the scenario into disarray. However, an unexpected turn of events led him to easily defeat a powerful demon that even the hero is hard-pressed to defeat. And to make matters worse, he did that in front of his favorite heroine in the game... Upon this incident, word started getting out about his true strength...!

daff740d-4af7-4f53-a4d1-e5841e289177.title: A Tyrant's First Love
daff740d-4af7-4f53-a4d1-e5841e289177.description:
From the moment she woke up in a foreign country, Dia knew she was fated for misery. With no memories of her past and unaccustomed to the language, she was taken in by a baron’s house. For four long years, she was beaten and abused with only the eldest son of House Knolls as a friend. 

But everything changed when the sadistic emperor of the Caios Empire, who was notorious for having a macabre hobby, barged into the mansion and gazed deeply into Dia’s eyes. From that moment on, she was whisked away into a gothic nightmare of blood and lust. Could Emperor Caire hold the key to unlocking Dia’s past?

c16942fe-057e-4b84-b946-fda7f7b6b12d.description:
Machino, seorang siswa SMA yang mendambakan "cinta takdir," menemukan sebuah game simulasi kencan bernama Celestia. Meskipun sudah memaksimalkan tingkat afeksi dengan semua heroine, dia tidak bisa memutuskan hanya pada satu pilihan, membuatnya menghabiskan hari-hari penuh kegelisahan tanpa dapat melanjutkan ke acara pengakuan cinta. Pada saat itu, sebuah ledakan terjadi bersamaan dengan jatuhnya bintang di rumahnya, dan ketika dia membuka matanya, dia bertemu dengan heroine utama dari Celestia, Sofia...

"Machino... aku selalu ingin mengatakannya... Aku suka kamu."

45777a73-98a6-47ba-b7df-e879365cb1cb.title: Evergreen
45777a73-98a6-47ba-b7df-e879365cb1cb.description:
Yoshimatsu Hotaka is the president of the manga club and is always diligent with his school life and club activities, but even though he looks like a regular honor student in reality we have that there is something really odd with him; he has this bitter ~ heavy ~ melancholic look and is almost always looking at Awaya Niki, the beautiful, bright, radiant, super cheerful swimming club's female ace.  
  
Why does Hotaka act all bitter like that? And what will become of him as the sports teacher orders him to have at least 'one secret swimming class lesson' where no one is supposed to be looking, whereas he normally skips class activities due to personal matters?

b970d58d-a839-4ce2-89d1-95f6bf133139.title: Urijip Romeo
b970d58d-a839-4ce2-89d1-95f6bf133139.description:
Kembali ke rumah untuk liburan musim panas, Sol bertemu dengan seorang pria misterius bernama Romi. Ketika hidup bersama yang tidak nyaman dimulai dengannya, yang tampaknya adalah pacar ibunya.

Sol menemukan dirinya terjebak dalam jaring kecurigaan dan kesalahpahaman yang terus-menerus, Namun, seiring berjalannya waktu, perasaan tulus Romi perlahan terungkap, bertabrakan dengan konflik Sol dengan ibunya dan perasaan Do-Hyun, teman masa kecilnya, terhadapnya. 

Terjerat dalam kegembiraan dan kebingungan, sebuah kisah musim panas yang panas tentang kesalahpahaman dan momen-momen yang membuat hati berdebar-debar pun terungkap.

c6a17411-0f3f-4b55-adfc-1a9515bae9ea.description:
from cotton candy scans:  
  
Misaki, whose father is the president of a company, has always been alone despite leading a wealthy life. Her father has entrusted his capable subordinate, Miyashita-san, to look after Misaki! Even though Misaki is confused about living together with the handsome older man all of a sudden, he keeps his calm demeanour and says that "this is just work". But while living together with him, she started to notice her heart racing more for the slightly ditzy and very kind Miyashita-san… A rich lady x capable subordinate's 24-hour heart-racing love!! An age-gap, cohabitation love.

1aca5c7d-f9db-4b8f-90a3-d56bf357ecb9.title: Burning Kabaddi
1aca5c7d-f9db-4b8f-90a3-d56bf357ecb9.description:
The story centers on first-year high school student Tatsuya Yoigoshi, a former ace soccer player who dislikes sports.
He gets invited to join the team for an Indian contact sport called Kabaddi.
He scoffs at the idea at first but becomes interested after watching a kabaddi practice.

Won the 70th Shougakukan Manga Award.

45b8d08e-b3ca-4aa7-bb14-120a1ed3c72f.title: Wakaba-chan wa Wakarasetai!
45b8d08e-b3ca-4aa7-bb14-120a1ed3c72f.description:
One tomboy is determined to win the heart of her childhood best friend–but will it take more than a makeover to win him over?

Wakaba is cocky, condescending, foul-mouthed, and absolutely in love with her childhood friend, Daiki. For as long as they’ve known each other, Wakaba’s been the very image of a roughhousing tomboy, but all that’s about to change. When she shows up in front of him, wearing a cutesy, feminine outfit, will she get the hopeless late bloomer’s heart racing? When you can’t put your feelings into words, an image change might just be the right gambit!

*Source: Seven Seas Entertainment, Vol. 1*
